name: @repo/vespin-lint
description: Vespin's own oxlint rules, beside upstream's anti-slop plugin in tools/oxlint/anti-slop: the design system's press, heading, skeleton, row, shortcut and shadcn focus-ring guards and its retired classes, glyphs and patterns, the testing policy's mock, skip and source-read rules, Drizzle writes, and the app's own one-place rules; the style guard over its CSS and class strings; and the repository guards over what a lint rule cannot see
